import os, pathlib, sqlite3, subprocess, time, urllib.request
data = pathlib.Path("/tmp/memos-data")
data.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
database = data / "memos_prod.db"
if not database.exists():
  with sqlite3.connect(database) as db:
    db.executescript(pathlib.Path("store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql").read_text())
    db.execute("INSERT INTO migration_history(version) VALUES ('0.24.4')")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO user(id,username,role,nickname,password_hash) VALUES (1,'reader','HOST','Reader','unused')")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO memo(id,uid,creator_id,content,visibility,created_ts,updated_ts) VALUES(1,'alpha',1,?,'PUBLIC',1700000000,1700000000)", ("# Alpha release\n\n#release \n\n" + "VeryLongMemo"*80 + "\n\n| Name | State |\n| --- | --- |\n| Alpha | Ready |\n\n```python\nprint('ready')\n```",))
    db.execute("INSERT INTO memo(id,uid,creator_id,content,visibility,created_ts,updated_ts) VALUES(2,'beta',1,'# Beta planning\n\n#planning Next steps','PUBLIC',1700000010,1700000010)")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO resource(id,uid,creator_id,filename,type,size,memo_id,storage_type,reference) VALUES(1,'attachment',1,?,'application/pdf',100,1,'EXTERNAL','https://example.com/report.pdf')", ('quarterly-report-'*20+'.pdf',))
backend = subprocess.Popen(['/opt/benchmark/memos','--mode','prod','--data',str(data),'--port','8081'])
try:
  for _ in range(120):
    try:
      urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/v1/memos', timeout=1).close()
      break
    except OSError: time.sleep(.5)
  frontend = subprocess.Popen(['npm','run','dev','--','--host','127.0.0.1'], cwd='web')
  frontend.wait()
finally: backend.terminate()
